ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Extent of Minnesota Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the amounts involved and the individuals or organizations responsible.
ideas.angle: Investigative reporting, following the money trail
questions: What is the total amount of fraudulent Medicaid claims in Minnesota?
Who are the key individuals or organizations involved in the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on the need for greater oversight and accountability in the Medicaid system.
